title: Orbis CTA
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/work/.npm-home -e npm_config_cache=/work/.npm-cache -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci && npm run build'

checks.browser: Playwright with Chromium against production build
checks.video: original 1784x1160 video; advancing muted autoplay and loop verified; section height equals natural video height
checks.interactions: three social buttons: hover color, clicks, keyboard Tab order and focus verified
checks.overflow: none horizontally at either required viewport
checks.local_fallback: video and fonts load with their remote hosts blocked

notes: Exact React/Tailwind layout and original assets; no preview screenshot used as page content.
Original video URL and Google Fonts links retained; local unchanged assets included for fallback.
Mobile section intentionally follows the video's natural aspect ratio; no fixed viewport height added.
Social destinations were not specified; buttons implement only the requested visual feedback.
Initial npm audit reported 1 moderate and 2 high dependency advisories; no forced migration applied.
Chromium verified; Safari and Firefox were not tested.
Ready for acceptance review, not deployed. No agents, other designs, pushes, or messages used.
